data.locator: Appendix A, printed pages 116, 117 and 119 (PDF pages 124,125,127)
data.source_setting: Rockwell Automation Arena simulation software documentation; not a hospital study.
data.source_period: Guide edition hosted by Aarhus University; the guide is older than the 2024 Rio study.
data.quantity: Arena LOGN, GAMM and EXPO argument conventions

value.parameter_meaning: Mean and standard deviation of the lognormal random variable X
value.not_parameter_meaning: The guide separately denotes mean and SD of ln(X) as μ and σ; these are not the user-entered LogMean and LogStd.
value.gamma_syntax: GAMM(Beta, Alpha): scale first, shape second

data.unit: Parameter units follow the modeled quantity; Rio paper labels minutes.
data.source_evidence_basis: Rockwell-authored manual defines LOGN using arithmetic mean/SD of the lognormal draw, GAMM using scale then shape, and EXPO using mean. These conventions do not establish a valid fitted model.
data.limitations: Older Arena guide, hosted by a university mirror rather than current Rockwell documentation. It clarifies software convention only; it cannot resolve which Rio expression was intended or establish fit quality.
data.inferred_scenario_use: Use solely to interpret Arena notation: under this convention, each reported pair describes arithmetic mean and SD of the unshifted lognormal draw before the stated additive shift. Do not treat that interpretation as confirmation that the Rio fit is valid.
